title: Crispy Deodeok Bites with Thai Som Sauce
description: A crunchy and flavorful snack from Korean and Thai cuisine, featuring deodeok, som, and tum in a sweet and spicy sauce.
instructions: Cut the deodeok into bite-sized pieces and set aside.
In a bowl, mix together the diced jagged tum and crispy root.
In a separate bowl, mix together the Thai som sauce and vegetable oil.
Add the deodeok to the bowl with the tum and root mixture, and toss to coat.
Drizzle the som sauce mixture over the deodeok mixture and toss to coat.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the deodeok bites in a single layer.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
